lines.zh: 我拍着大翅膀在林间滑。
lines.en: I beat my broad wings between the trees.
I fly steadily through the night.

lines.zh: 我绕过树干，翅膀擦过树皮。
lines.en: I round a trunk, wings brushing the bark.

lines.zh: 我贴着树冠飞，风在翼下。
lines.en: I fly along the canopy with wind under my wings.

lines.zh: 我从一片林子飞到另一片。
lines.en: I go from one stand of trees to the next.
Grey-white bands run across my wings.
I rise slowly over the shrubs.
I follow the smell of damp air.

lines.zh: 我的身体很沉，翅膀要用力。
lines.en: My body is heavy; my wings must work.

lines.zh: 我在林间空地上兜了一圈。
lines.en: I circle the clearing once.
I pump my wings, stroke by stroke.

lines.zh: 我沿着溪边的树飞过去。
lines.en: I fly the trees along the creek.
A little of my wing dust falls.
I turn aside from a web.
I slip between leaves.
I fly all night long.
I rest on bark with my wings folded.
The night is cool; I keep still.
Dew settles on my wings.
I'm waiting for the smell of a flower.
I hide in the tree's shadow.

lines.zh: 我的翅纹在暗里看不出来。
lines.en: My markings vanish in the dark.

lines.zh: 我听见了远处的拍翅声。
lines.en: I hear wingbeats far off.

lines.zh: 我把翅张开一点，又合上。
lines.en: I open my wings a little and close them.
I eat only a little in a night.
I haven't much time.

lines.zh: 我停在橡树皮上，翅收得紧。
lines.en: I rest on oak bark with my wings folded tight.
I shift slowly along the trunk.
The dew weighs me down a little.

lines.zh: 你抬头看我，我翅上的眼纹对着你。
lines.en: You look up; the eye-spot on my wing faces you.

lines.zh: 我落在你够得到的枝上。
lines.en: I settle on a branch you can reach.
I know that net in your hand.
I open my wings slowly.
Keep your hands down and I won't fly.

lines.zh: 我这么大，你很难看不见。
lines.en: I'm large enough that you can't miss me.
Reach out and I'll fly.

lines.zh: 我把身子侧过来给你看。
lines.en: I turn sideways so you can see.

lines.zh: 我的翅比你的手掌还宽。
lines.en: My wings are wider than your palm.
You're very close now.
I shake my wings and crumbs of dust fall.
A corner of my wing is missing.
I land, wings still shaking.
I press to the bark and stay still.
Some of my markings are worn away.

lines.zh: 我飞不到刚才那么高了。
lines.en: I can't reach the height I had.
My body feels heavier.
I fold my wings slowly.
I'd like to fly a while longer.

lines.zh: 那朵花的味道我闻到了。
lines.en: I've caught the smell of that flower.
I feed with my wings moving.
When I'm done I'll go to the next.
I've landed on your hand.
It isn't a flower, but it smells like one.
I stay a while before leaving.
I've left pollen on it.
This flower will seed because of me.

lines.zh: 你碰到了我的翅，我歪了一下。
lines.en: You touch my wing and I tilt.
I beat hard and steady myself.
The knock drops me a little.
I circle and come back.
I land on a nearby leaf.

lines.zh: 这一下让我的翅尖折了。
lines.en: That creases my wing tip.
My wings are fragile; a touch costs dust.
I climb back to my old height.

lines.zh: 我们两个在林间绕圈飞。
lines.en: The two of us spiral through the trees.
Her wings are a little whiter.
We follow the same scent.
She settles on the underside of a leaf.
I spread my wings so she sees them.
She lifts off; I follow.
There are only the two of us in the night.
She leaves eggs on the leaf.

lines.zh: 那些卵会在这里过完冬天。
lines.en: Those eggs will see the winter through here.

lines.zh: 我落在花上，把口器伸进去。
lines.en: I settle on the bloom and reach in.

lines.zh: 我在那朵花上吸了很久。
lines.en: I drink at that bloom a long while.

lines.zh: 我把花粉沾到下一朵上。
lines.en: I carry pollen to the next bloom.
This one has nothing left.
I'm only resting, not feeding.
My proboscis rolls back up.
I can't reach that deep.
I move to another.
I've had my fill and my wings feel heavy.
I'm off to find the next patch.
There's the smell of a bloom.
A giant night moth that only wants orchids.
My wings move first, then my body.
The smell is faint, but close.
I fly that way slowly.
I keep clear of that web strand.
Something stands between us.
I climb a little to pass above.
Nearly there; my wings have slowed.
I'm ready to settle.
It keeps moving; I circle with it.

lines.zh: 花就在那一片叶子后面。
lines.en: The bloom is behind that leaf.
I circle once and find my angle.

lines.zh: 我把翅收窄些，好穿过去。
lines.en: I narrow my wings to slip through.

lines.zh: 前面有蛛网，我绕了远路。
lines.en: A web ahead; I go the long way.
My wings are getting tired.
The night moth circles the orchid.
Now I'm going to settle.

lines.zh: 我扬起鳞粉，扑到你脸上。
lines.en: I beat up a cloud of dust into your face.
I buffet you with my wings, twice.
My wing edge grazes your hand.
I bump into you — very lightly.
I haven't much to fight with.

lines.zh: 你一动，我翅上的粉全掉了。
lines.en: One move from you and my dust is gone.
I lift and come down again.
I'm frantic; my wings beat raggedly.
I struggle out of the cocoon.
I wait a long time for them to harden.
Only when it's dark can I fly.

lines.zh: 我第一次看见这片林子。
lines.en: First sight of this wood.
I try one beat of my wings.
I fly half a foot and land.

lines.zh: 压在我翅上的露水很凉。
lines.en: The dew on my wings is cold.

lines.zh: 空气里全是花和树的味道。
lines.en: The air tastes of flowers and wood.
I have a long way to fly tonight.
Fire curls the edges of my wings.

lines.zh: 我掉在地上，翅拍不起来。
lines.en: I hit the ground and my wings won't lift.
Dew drowns me and I can't move.

lines.zh: 冲击把我吹得翻了几个圈。
lines.en: The blast throws me spinning.

lines.zh: 一根尖物穿过了我的翅。
lines.en: Something sharp goes through my wing.

lines.zh: 那道光让我的鳞粉全掉了。
lines.en: The light strips the dust from my wings.

lines.zh: 我找不到花，快撑不住了。
lines.en: I can't find a bloom; I'm fading.

lines.zh: 雷光一闪，我抖得像片叶子。
lines.en: Lightning flashes and I shake like a leaf.

lines.zh: 下面什么都没有，我一直飘。
lines.en: Nothing below; I drift on and on.
